physics_configuration.report: scripts/platform_report.py --id <platform id> writes docs/validation/platforms/<id>.json with the GPU name, compute capability, driver (nvidia-smi), CUDA runtime (torch.version.cuda), torch, CuPy, numpy, Python, OS and the free/total device memory at the time of the record; the interpreter path is written with the home directory replaced by '<user home>'
physics_configuration.matrix: docs/PLATFORM_MATRIX.md, one row per platform; hardware cells are copied from the record file or read 'not recorded'
physics_configuration.growth: a platform enters the matrix only through a record written by scripts/platform_report.py on that host (under WSL2, inside the distribution); its row is copied from that record, and the OS cell states WSL2 where the record's platform string does
recorded_platforms: rtx3060-wsl2-ubuntu2204: WSL2 Ubuntu 22.04 on the RTX 3060 lab host, the same GPU and Windows driver through the WSL CUDA driver; not a native Linux install
physics_configuration.platform_g4_runs: scripts/record_platform_g4.py writes docs/validation/platforms/g4/<id>.json and a byte-for-byte copy of every JUnit report under docs/validation/platforms/g4/<id>/ from the JUnit reports of every G4 task's planned command and of scripts/run_suite.py gpu-nightly, run on that platform at one clean commit from a checkout outside the home directory; it executes no test and does not touch the gate file

reference_method: the record file written by scripts/platform_report.py on the machine itself; the matrix test cross-checks every table cell against that file and rejects a row whose cells are not backed by a record. A platform G4 run record is checked against its own JUnit copies and the current G4 required_tests of docs/validation/completion_gates.json

observables.name: record_fields
observables.definition: record_version, recorded_at, os, python, torch, cupy, cuda_runtime, torch_cuda_available, driver, gpus (name, compute_capability, total and free memory) present in a fresh report

observables.name: home_directory_in_record
observables.definition: a fresh report written by an interpreter that lies under the home directory contains that directory in any field

observables.name: matrix_consistency
observables.definition: every hardware cell of a recorded row equals the record; every cell of an unrecorded row reads 'not recorded'; every record file has a row

observables.name: local_gpu_recorded
observables.definition: the GPU torch reports on the test host has a record file

observables.name: platform_g4_run
observables.definition: for every docs/validation/platforms/g4/<id>.json: its platform has a record and a row whose 'Verified by' cell links it, and no row links a missing one; every JUnit copy matches its stored SHA-256 and re-parses to the recorded counts, failures, errors and skips; every run exited 0 with no failure, no error and no skip outside three expected classes (an optional platform check; an opt-in test whose reason names a TORCHFDTD_*=1 variable the run's command does not set; a check of a file that a record names on the host that wrote it, 'is not on this host'), each skip's class as recorded; no JUnit copy and no record names a home directory (/root/, /home/, /Users/, X:\Users\); a gpu-nightly run is present; for every G4 task the record names exactly the task's current required_tests, has a run of the task's own command, and every test those entries name passed in that run and in the gpu-nightly run

acceptance_limits.report: the report exits 0 and contains every listed field; with CUDA available it lists at least one GPU with a d.d compute capability and 0 <= free <= total memory; home_directory_in_record is false
acceptance_limits.matrix: no matrix row carries a value without a record file; at least one row is recorded
acceptance_limits.platform_g4_run: platform_g4_run is true; the recorder itself names every test of a file entry (pytest --collect-only through the task's command), reports a failed test as not passed and an unexpected skip as such with a nonzero exit, classifies skip reasons as declared, and refuses a run set without a task or the suite, a report that names the home directory and a dirty tree

applicable_scope: G4-01: platform inventory and matrix under the revised case G4-01r2 (rtx3060-win11-lab, rtx3060-wsl2-ubuntu2204 with its G4 run record) at 338757eaab1d re-recorded on 2c5f3754c047 for the release candidate.
verification_reason: no failures or errors, and no required test skipped or absent
